style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">terms and conditions that were applicable to the Award immediately prior to the Change in Control except that, if the Award related to shares, the Award instead confers the right to receive common stock of the acquiring entity.</font></div></div><h1 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;" id="section_14__amendment_and_termination_"><font The Board shall obtain approval</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">of the Company&#x2019;s stockholders for any amendment that would require such approval in order to satisfy the requirements of any rules of the stock exchange on which the Common Stock is</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">traded or other Applicable Law. The Administrator may amend the terms of any Award theretofore granted, prospectively or retroactively, but, subject to Section 5 and the immediately preceding sentence, no such amendment shall materially impair the rights of any Participant without the Participant&#x2019;s consent.</font></p><h1 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New The Company or any Affiliate may deduct, withhold or require payment of amounts necessary to satisfy such obligations, as determined by the Administrator in its sole discretion. The Administrator may permit or require satisfaction of such obligations by one or more of the following tax withholding methods: cash payment, payroll withholding, Share withholding (net Share issuance), delivery of previously owned</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font   <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;" id="section_17__transfer_of_awards_"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">voluntary</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">sell-to-cover</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">transaction, or any other method permitted by Applicable Laws. Shares withheld or delivered to satisfy tax withholding obligations shall be valued at Fair Market Value on the date the amount to be </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">withheld is determined.</font></p><h1 </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">of</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font individual&#x2019;s actions or omissions under the Plan, except as otherwise limited by applicable law or the </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times
